_comment: Two entries, so `a.js` and `w.js` are in one common chunk. `main.js` defers `a.js`, and `b.js` imports `a.js`, then `w.js`. The chunk runs `w.js` at load, and `w.js` has a top-level `await`, so it cannot move to a new chunk. Thus the chunk runs `a.js` at load, at its place, as the build without `import defer` does. The output runs `a` before `w`, as native ESM does.
